name: translation-invariant-clear-exit-v1
purpose: resume straight-line acceleration when the visible corridor has become parallel at a curve exit, without requiring the car to return to the image center first

evidence.code_cause: The generic _road_sweep compares sampled rows34,38,42 with unsampled rows58,62,66 and substitutes IMAGE_CENTER for the missing rows. A perfectly parallel corridor displaced6 pixels therefore reports sweep6, target53.7587 and brake0.0909 at speed60 even though its translation-invariant shape sweep is zero.
evidence.straight_gate: The inherited straight predicate additionally requires abs(center42-IMAGE_CENTER)<=1.25, so an aligned exit remains classified as a curve while the car recenters.
evidence.ema_finding: The normal clear-curve command bypasses the stored target EMA; EMA is not the primary exit delay. Obstacle and miss-latch conservatism is intentional and remains frozen.
evidence.video_finding: The latest 4_7 videos visibly favor the center line, but do not show a common abrupt recenter maneuver and contain no speed or pedal telemetry. Track3 race time11.36-12.56 is the clearest slow-recovery example, while Track1 race time17.76-20.16 is a counterexample. The videos motivate an exit transition but do not establish braking causality.

single_factor.name: translation-invariant clear-exit longitudinal gate
single_factor.shape_sweep: max(abs(center[row]-center[54]) for row in (30,34,38,42)), requiring all five sampled rows
clear_exit_gate: no obstacle latch at frame start and no active latch
single_factor.clear_exit_action: set command target68 and use the existing straight gas branches0.18/0.135/0.09 with the existing strict brake boundary speed>69
unchanged: all steering values, steering slew, recentering and obstacle pass-side behavior
all non-clear-exit curve targets, gas, coasting and braking
current obstacle targets47/40, obstacle+sweep>=6 target30, every miss-latch frame and the latch-clearing frame
lost-road behavior, observation/action interface and official environment files
model.pt, DrQ, explicit-export and HAIC policy routes
all track-id, seed, coordinate, elapsed-time and progress independence

static_and_synthetic: Bare state-dict routing selects only the candidate; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.
Parallel clear corridors displaced by -6 through +6 pixels use target68 and never brake at speed60; mirrored observations have equal longitudinal actions.
At the exact shape, heading, center-offset and steering boundaries the gate is closed with nextafter tests; any value above a boundary uses the parent action exactly.
True diagonal/curved road profiles remain parent-exact and cannot receive the clear-exit boost.
Current obstacle, every miss-latch frame, clearing frame and reacquisition remain action-identical to the control.
Steering is bit-exact to the control across directed and randomized tests; invalid input, road loss and reset remain inherited.
Actions remain finite and bounded, gas and brake never overlap, and gas above0.14 appears only in inherited exact straights or the registered clear-exit gate.
Affected/local/submission contract tests and an isolated exact-file package smoke pass.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: After governance restoration, compare candidate and exact control on preregistered unused multi-track geometry seeds. Completion rate, DNF, collision and worst progress may not regress before exit recovery or lap time is considered.
future_environment_gate.objective: Reduce curve-exit recovery time and move evaluation tracks toward the low-20-second range; source and synthetic validation cannot establish that outcome.

abort: Any runtime condition uses track id, seed, map identity, coordinate, time, progress or evaluation filename.
Any steering output, true-curve action, current-obstacle action, miss-latch action or latch-clearing-frame action differs from the control.
Any clear-exit boost occurs outside every registered inclusive boundary or with missing required rows.
Any action is non-finite/out of range, gas and brake overlap, package/interface gate fails, or relevant regression fails.
Any environment execution, training, submission, SOTA promotion or performance claim occurs while governance documents remain absent.
Any frozen environment/model/DrQ/active-study artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible; the official participant repository remains available and unchanged.
Only source, synthetic, unit and isolated package validation is authorized.
